about: OSM road model vs Vicmap Transport (pipeline/checks/vicmap_crosscheck.py). Reports only. Vicmap has no level or z field. 'vicmap_upper' comes mainly from the crossing node: at a bridge/tunnel node, conpfi1/conpfi2 name the road the structure carries (on top at a bridge, underneath at a tunnel). Only where the node does not decide does it fall back to the segment types (bridge > road > tunnel); where the two disagree the crossing is 'vicmap_inconsistent'. Vicmap lines are clipped to SIM_EXTRACT_BBOX; an unmatched structure is 'extract_edge' only if its Vicmap line was clipped or its OSM counterpart was cut at the extract edge (never by distance alone). Heights: clearance-based (roads_3d.py), see grade_separation.json.
